Strings.welcome.title: 🏠 RelaxKonOS
Strings.welcome.feature.window_manager: • Custom window manager — drag, resize, minimize, maximize, focus, and Z-order, all rendered locally.
Strings.welcome.feature.desktop: • Desktop: desktop icons, taskbar with live window list, and Start menu.
Strings.welcome.feature.local_apps: • Applications run and render locally — RelaxKonOS is not a remote desktop tool.
Strings.welcome.feature.built_in_apps: • Built-in apps: Welcome, Notebook, Settings, Terminal, Explorer, Browser, and Task Manager.
Strings.welcome.feature.server: • Server capabilities: authentication, SQLite persistence, file management, system monitoring, and workspace preference sync.
